name: MarkOnMap
description: Mark a place on the player's map when they ask the way and you know where it is.
note: Marks a place on your map when you ask the way and the NPC knows it. No fast travel. Needs Mantella's Advanced Actions on. Dawnguard and Dragonborn places need those DLCs.

place.description: The place, as people call it (e.g. Bleak Falls Barrow).

prompt: If the player asks you the way to a place you know and you show them where it is, begin your response with '{key}:'
